title: clerodendrum cephalanthum var. schliebenii
intro: Clerodendrum cephalanthum var. schliebenii, commonly known as a shrub native to tropical regions, is a plant species within the Lamiaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its purported health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues due to its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Clerodendrum cephalanthum var. schliebenii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, although specific information on these compounds is limited. Further research is necessary to confirm the efficacy and full range of bioactive constituents in this plant.
